verdict.rationale: Casium's site describes a pricing model: "No billable hours. No RFE or assessment fees" and "all for one clear price." But the pack explicitly notes that the price itself is not published, and no flat-fee figures or priced service menu appear anywhere. A founder therefore cannot see real prices before talking to anyone; flat-price messaging without published numbers is only adjacent to this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see real prices before I talk to anyone — published flat fees or a priced service menu on the provider's own site
